top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a mature, independently confirmed chain from incretin physiology and native GLP-1 (Holst) and proglucagon and receptor biology (Drucker) to the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide (Mojsov), now backed by large randomized trials on glycaemia, weight and cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The citation is scoped to the physiology and active form, acknowledging therapy by wording. The unresolved attribution (Habener, Knudsen excluded under the three-name cap) is a real weakness but does not outweigh the case for awarding it over no award.
